description: 中间攻击挂车，再组织将杀
explanation_en: An intermediate attack targets the undefended rook before White switches to a mating attack.

intro.popup: 💡 中间招：黑车a8无根是挂子。白方先Qa5！中间攻击挂车——黑方必须应对，白方再转为将杀！
intro.popup_en: 💡 Intermediate move: Black's rook on a8 is undefended. White first plays Qa5, an intermediate attack on the rook that Black must answer, then switches to a mating attack.

outro.popup: ✅ 要点：Qa5中间捉挂车！黑方Re8应对，Qg5转移——白方攻势更强！
outro.popup_en: ✅ Key idea: Qa5 is an intermediate attack on the loose rook. After ...Re8, Qg5 shifts to a stronger attack.

moves.popup: 白后Qa5！中间招——攻击无根的黑车a8（挂子），同时准备Qg5将攻！
moves.popup_en: Qa5! An intermediate move that attacks Black's undefended rook on a8 while preparing a mating attack with Qg5.

moves.popup: 黑车Re8——应对白后威胁，车移至e8守住！
moves.popup_en: The rook moves to e8 to meet the queen's threat and defend itself.

moves.popup: 白后Qg5！中间招连续——转移攻击，白方发动将杀威胁！
moves.popup_en: Qg5! White shifts the attack and creates a mating threat.
